records.jp: あっ！　あの星大きい！
records.en_original: Wow! That one's really bright!
records.en_auxiliary: Wow! That one's really bright!
records.en: Ah! That star is big!

records.jp: あのあたりの方角だと……金星かしら
records.en_original: Given the location...I'd say it must be Venus.
records.en_auxiliary: Given the location...I'd say it must be Venus.
records.en: Given the location...I'd say it must be Venus.

records.jp: でも、雫世界って、やっぱ不思議だなー。<CR>ちゃんとこうして星空が見えたりするし
records.en_original: Man, Oasis is a strange place. We can see all the same stars as back home.
records.en_auxiliary: Man, Oasis is a strange place. We can see all the same stars as back home.
records.en: Oasis really is strange.<CR>We can properly see a starry sky like this.

records.jp: この世界が私たちの想いからできているというなら、<CR>私たちの知っている宇宙があっても不思議ではないわ
records.en_original: Since this world is made up of our emotions, it's not surprising that the space we know exists here.
records.en_auxiliary: Since this world is made up of our emotions, it's not surprising that the space we know exists here.
records.en: Since this world is made up of our emotions,<CR>it's not surprising that the space we know exists here.

records.jp: 言われてみれば、そうなのかも
records.en_original: When you put it that way, I guess that makes sense.
records.en_auxiliary: When you put it that way, I guess that makes sense.
records.en: When you put it that way, I guess that makes sense.

records.jp: 知っている星空と同じなら、いろいろ説明して<CR>あげられると思う
records.en_original: If it's the same as the night sky we know, I might be able to point some things out.
records.en_auxiliary: If it's the same as the night sky we know, I might be able to point some things out.
records.en: If it's the same as the night sky we know,<CR>I might be able to point some things out.

records.jp: だからって、同じ宇宙になるかな？<CR>完璧に星空を覚えてる人なんていないだろうし……
records.en_original: How can we be sure it's the same? Nobody can remember the night sky perfectly...
records.en_auxiliary: How can we be sure it's the same? Nobody can remember the night sky perfectly...
records.en: How can we be sure it's the same?<CR>Nobody can remember the night sky perfectly...

records.jp: あら。私、星には結構自信があるけれど、<CR>私の知識から外れた景色ではなさそうよ
records.en_original: Well, I'm quite confident in my knowledge of the stars and I don't see any that seem out of place.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, I'm quite confident in my knowledge of the stars and I don't see any that seem out of place.
records.en: Well, I'm fairly confident in my knowledge of the stars,<CR>and this sky doesn't seem beyond what I know.

records.jp: 良かったらいろいろ教えてあげようか？
records.en_original: I can tell you more if you'd like.
records.en_auxiliary: I can tell you more if you'd like.
records.en: I can tell you more if you'd like.

records.jp: せっかく星を見るなら、いろんな知識を<CR>知っていた方が楽しめると思うし……
records.en_original: Stargazing is a lot more interesting if you know what you're looking at...
records.en_auxiliary: Stargazing is a lot more interesting if you know what you're looking at...
records.en: Stargazing is a lot more interesting<CR>if you know what you're looking at...

records.jp: 美弦さん……
records.en_original: Mio...
records.en_auxiliary: Mio...
records.en: Mio-san...

records.jp: ぜひ教えてほしい！<CR>美弦さんの話だったら、絶対面白いもん
records.en_original: Tell me everything you know! You can make anything sound interesting.
records.en_auxiliary: Tell me everything you know! You can make anything sound interesting.
records.en: Please do!<CR>Any explanation from you is sure to be interesting.

records.jp: そこまで期待されるとやりづらいけれど……。<CR>でも、聞いてもらえるのは嬉しい
records.en_original: I'm not sure I can live up to your expectations... But I'm glad you're interested.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm not sure I can live up to your expectations... But I'm glad you're interested.
records.en: That much expectation makes it difficult, but...<CR>I'm happy you'll listen.

records.jp: 私、星が好きだから
records.en_original: I love the stars.
records.en_auxiliary: I love the stars.
records.en: I love the stars.

records.jp: まったく、ホントに優しいんだから
records.en_original: You really are so kind.
records.en_auxiliary: You really are so kind.
records.en: You really are so kind.

records.jp: 優しい……のかしら？<CR>優しくありたいとは思っているけれど……
records.en_original: Am I...? I do try to be kind, but...
records.en_auxiliary: Am I...? I do try to be kind, but...
records.en: Am I...?<CR>I do try to be kind, but...

records.jp: 優しいよ。<CR>人を楽しませようって行動できるの、すごいと思うもん
records.en_original: You are. I think it's great how you try to help other people enjoy things.
records.en_auxiliary: You are. I think it's great how you try to help other people enjoy things.
records.en: You are.<CR>I think it's great how you try to help other people enjoy things.

records.jp: いつか、現実の世界の星空を、<CR>こんなふうに美弦さんと一緒に見たいなぁ
records.en_original: Someday, I want to look up at the real stars with you, just like this.
records.en_auxiliary: Someday, I want to look up at the real stars with you, just like this.
records.en: Someday,<CR>I want to look at the stars in the real world with you like this, Mio-san.

records.jp: そうね。叶うなら、私も……
records.en_original: Yes, that would be nice.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, that would be nice.
records.en: Yes. If it can come true, I would like that too...

records.jp: じゃあ、こうしようよ
records.en_original: Well then...
records.en_auxiliary: Well then...
records.en: Well then...

records.jp: いつか絶対、現実世界に戻って、<CR>一緒に天体望遠鏡を覗くって約束しよ！
records.en_original: Let's promise that one day, we'll go back to the real world and look through a telescope together!
records.en_auxiliary: Let's promise that one day, we'll go back to the real world and look through a telescope together!
records.en: Let's promise that one day,<CR>we'll go back to the real world and look through a telescope together!

records.jp: でも……
records.en_original: But...
records.en_auxiliary: But...
records.en: But...

records.jp: や・く・そ・く！
records.en_original: P-R-O-M-I-S-E!
records.en_auxiliary: P-R-O-M-I-S-E!
records.en: P-R-O-M-I-S-E!

records.jp: もう。愛央は強引なんだから
records.en_original: Hey. You're being very pushy, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Hey. You're being very pushy, Ao.
records.en: Honestly. You're so forceful, Ao.

records.jp: 私、本気だから
records.en_original: That's because I mean it.
records.en_auxiliary: That's because I mean it.
records.en: That's because I mean it.

records.jp: わかった。約束する
records.en_original: All right, then. I promise.
records.en_auxiliary: All right, then. I promise.
records.en: All right, then. I promise.

records.jp: 愛央。私も、あなたと一緒の未来を想ったら<CR>なんだか楽しくなってきたわ
records.en_original: Ao... Imagining a future with you makes me feel excited.
records.en_auxiliary: Ao... Imagining a future with you makes me feel excited.
records.en: Ao. Imagining a future together with you<CR>is somehow starting to make me excited.

records.jp: 私を信じてみてよ。<CR>それ、絶対叶えてみせるから！
records.en_original: Just trust me. I'll definitely make it happen!
records.en_auxiliary: Just trust me. I'll definitely make it happen!
records.en: Just trust me.<CR>I'll definitely make it happen!

records.jp: あなたのことは信じているけれど……
records.en_original: I've always trusted you...
records.en_auxiliary: I've always trusted you...
records.en: I do trust you, but...

records.jp: じゃあ、叶うっていうのも信じて。<CR>私たちは絶対、現実の世界に帰れるって
records.en_original: Then you have to trust that it'll come true. We'll definitely make it back to the real world.
records.en_auxiliary: Then you have to trust that it'll come true. We'll definitely make it back to the real world.
records.en: Then you have to trust that it'll come true.<CR>We'll definitely make it back to the real world.

records.jp: わかった。信じるわ
records.en_original: Okay. I trust you.
records.en_auxiliary: Okay. I trust you.
records.en: Okay. I trust you.

records.jp: よーし！　元気出てきた！
records.en_original: All right! That's what I like to hear!
records.en_auxiliary: All right! That's what I like to hear!
records.en: All right! I'm feeling better now!

records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
